data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2021 with gross claims outstanding of 543.919m (USD). During the year there was net adverse prior-year development, driven by adverse development across several closed years (notably deterioration in the Healthcare class), and impacts related to COVID-19 (largely addressed via an intra-group Loss Portfolio Transfer). Using the gross claims development table, the re-estimation of underwriting years prior to 2020 produced a net adverse movement of approximately 16.8m (USD), representing ~3.1% of opening gross claims outstanding. The Loss Portfolio Transfer removed the majority of the COVID-19 impact, leaving a very small net COVID balance on the balance sheet at year end.
raw_causal_phrases: There were deteriorations on our closed years (2009-2018) primarily on the Healthcare class ($4.7m) contributing to an overall deterioration on closed years of $2.6m.
In the financial year there was prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $5.3 million (2020: $1.1 million adverse).
The Loss Portfolio Transfer agreement with Berkley Insurance Company has removed all net impact of COVID-19 losses from the Syndicate

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development has been estimated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 32-33). The source triangle text contains OCR artifacts in the extracted copy; several cell values required interpretation (e.g. '07,202' interpreted as 107,202). A narrative sentence quantifying prior-year adverse 'claims incurred' ($5.3m) exists but is a P&L 'claims incurred' figure (explicitly warned in instructions) and was not used as the gross prior-year reserve movement. A Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and reinsurance arrangements materially affect the comparability of gross/net movements; where only net figures are reported in narrative, gross equivalents were derived from the triangle when possible. Confidence in the triangle-derived prior-year movement is moderate (0.5) due to OCR uncertainty and potential distortions from transfers/reinsurance.
